title: geodesiq: a Python package for geometric diabatic–adiabatic optimal state transfer
description: We introduce the geodesiq Python package, which implements a geometric framework for shaping control pulses that achieve high-fidelity state transfer in multilevel quantum systems. The underlying method combines adiabatic and diabatic control in a single metric, which suppresses unwanted excitations while allowing selected diabatic passages. Finding the pulse thereby reduces to solving a single first-order ordinary differential equation. We explain how to use geodesiq and illustrate it with Landau–Zener transitions, spin-qubit initialization, adiabatic many-body ground-state preparation, and a diabatic–adiabatic transfer in a four-level system.
